# Climate Change & Food Security

> > A comprehensive resource analyzing climate change impacts on global food security, crop yields, and agricultural vulnerability using IPCC, FAO, and NASA data.

This site synthesizes scientific research on the interconnections between climate change and food security, featuring analysis from major institutions like the IPCC, FAO, and National Research Council. It provides both foundational science and regional assessments of climate impacts on agriculture, with particular focus on vulnerable regions like Sub-Saharan Africa.

## Key Topics

- Food Security
- Crop Yields
- Climate Change Impacts
- IPCC Reports
- Agricultural Risk
- Global Warming
- Climate Science
- Food Production
- Regional Food Production
- CO2 Fertilization
- Drought Analysis
- Palmer Drought Severity Index (PDSI)
- Food Insecurity
- Crop Yield Projections
- Climate-Agriculture Linkages

## Core Science & Overview

- [Homepage](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/index.html): Homepage covering climate change impacts on food security with IPCC and FAO data
- [About Climate Change & Food Security](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/about.html): Site overview by Climate Emergency Institute on climate-agriculture links
- [Science Fundamentals](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/science.html): Core science on global warming impacts to agriculture and crop yields
- [Dual-Aspect Analysis](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/dual_aspect.html): Dual-aspect analysis of climate change and food security impacts
- [Multiple Impacts Overview](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/many_impacts.html): Comprehensive overview of climate change impacts on food security
- [Background Fundamentals](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/background.html): Background overview of climate change and food security fundamentals

## Climate & Crop Yield Projections

- [Dangerous Climate Thresholds](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/dangerous.html): Assessment of dangerous climate warming thresholds for food security
- [National Research Council 2010 Report](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/nrc.html): NRC 2010 report on climate change impacts and crop yield projections
- [CO2 Fertilization Effects](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/co2_fertilzn.html): CO2 fertilization effects on crop yields and photosynthesis analysis
- [Climate Crop Models](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/models.html): Climate computer models and GCM assessment for agriculture impacts
- [Cline Agricultural Impact Assessment](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/cline.html): W. Cline's 2007 agricultural impact assessment of climate change
- [IPCC Temperature Conversion Methodology](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/ipcc_conversion.html): IPCC temperature conversion and climate model assessment methodology

## Drought & Water Stress

- [Global Drought Analysis](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/drought.html): Global drought analysis under climate change using PDSI index
- [IPCC Drought Trends](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/ipcc_drought.html): IPCC SREX drought trends and regional climate projections analysis
- [Historical Drought Trends](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/drought_history.html): Historical drought trends and PDSI analysis for agricultural regions
- [Drought Research & Policy](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/drought_news.html): Current drought research and climate policy implications for food security

## Regional Vulnerability Assessment

- [Sub-Saharan Africa Food Security](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/africa.html): Sub-Saharan Africa food security vulnerability to climate change

## Research & Updates

- [Recent Research Review](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/recent_research.html): Recent research review on climate change impacts to food crops

## Optional References

- [Tropospheric Ozone Impacts](https://www.climatechange-foodsecurity.org/trop_ozone.html): Tropospheric ozone impacts on crop damage and air pollution effects
